name: Sanofi
businessSummary: French biopharma focused on Immunology (Dupixent), Rare diseases and Vaccines (Beyfortus, flu, others). Pipeline rebuilding via BD and M&A after tolebrutinib setback.

price.source: stock-agent /decisions 2026-11-12 23:05; twelvedata.com SAN statistics (update 11 Nov 17:30 CET)

netDebt.note: EUR m; implied only, definition (IFRS 16, minorities) unknown. Company Q3 net debt figure not retrieved.

peTrailing.note: twelvedata 25.70. Inflated by IFRS impairments (tolebrutinib EUR 2.24bn). On business EPS FY2025 EUR 7.83: 86.61/7.83 = 11.1.

peForward.note: Consistent with business EPS about 9; 2026 guidance business EPS growth mid-teens CER, FX -1pp.

fcfTTM.note: EUR m assumed (article gives '8.1bn', +35.8%); TTM to Q3 2026 not retrieved.

dividendYield.note: twelvedata shows 'forward rate 16.48' which is a data error.

payoutRatio.note: IFRS-earnings basis, depressed by impairments; payout on business EPS about 53% (4.12/7.83, derived).

sales.note: EUR m, +14.3% CER (+16.2% reported). 9M IFRS net income 4,979 (Q3 3,021). IFRS EPS and business operating income not retrieved.

guidance2026.note: Upgraded (also upgraded at Q2): sales growth low-teens CER (initial guidance high single-digit); business EPS growth mid-teens CER (initial: slightly faster than sales); vaccine sales low single-digit decline; tax about 21%; FX about -1% sales and EPS. New EUR 1bn buyback announced with FY2025.

dupixent.note: EUR m, +32.2%; 2030 ambition about EUR 25bn at CER. Dupixent patent expiry year not verified in retrieved sources (no figure stated).

history.source: hl.co.uk FY2025 article; revenue +9.9% CER (currency assumed EUR); eps = business EPS; business operating income not retrieved

consensus.note: 3 strong buy + 9 buy, 12 hold, 0 sell (sums to 24 vs 23 stated).

forwardEstimates.source: unavailable; 2027 early view: demand-led growth, slightly negative pricing, about EUR 1.3bn sales impact from Cheplapharm and Medley divestments (subject to closing)

recentEvents: Q3 2026 (30 Oct): sales +14.3% CER, business EPS +19.6% CER; guidance upgraded.
Pharma launches EUR 2.176bn (15% of sales); vaccines declined (seasonal phasing, lower Beyfortus).
Tolebrutinib PPMS trial failed (FY2025), EUR 2.24bn impairment; four-antibody collaboration with 50/50 profit share; Cheplapharm and Medley divestments.
valueTrapFlags: Vaccines declining; US vaccine weakness and lower Beyfortus.
IFRS P/E and payout ratio distorted by impairments (P/E 25, payout 119%).
dataGaps: EBIT/business operating income and multi-year history not retrieved
Company-reported net debt and TTM FCF not retrieved
Sanofi press release URL was blocked (permission); Q3 data from Quartr summary

valuation.method: Next-12m business EPS x justified P/E. Basis EUR 9.0 (provider forward P/E 9.35 implies about 9.26; trailing IFRS EPS distorted by impairments; lead estimate). Bear weighted 30% for Dupixent concentration. Historical multiple ranges not verified by agents; justified multiples are lead estimates.

bear.note: Vaccines keep declining, pipeline disappoints, Dupixent peaks. Justified multiple 9x on next-12m 9.00.

base.note: Dupixent and launches drive mid-single-digit growth to 2030. Justified multiple 12x on next-12m 9.54.

bull.note: Immunology pipeline (amlitelimab, tolebrutinib) succeeds. Justified multiple 14x on next-12m 9.81.

valuation.whyItFits: Low beta (0.26), 4.8% dividend, net debt/EBITDA 0.9x, forward P/E about 9-10; guidance upgraded and BNP upgrade to Outperform (2026-11-09).
valuation.growthDrivers: Dupixent indications, Beyfortus, immunology pipeline, buybacks.
valuation.saturation: Low multiple versus pharma peers; consensus target 95.70 (analyst opinion). Undervalued if Dupixent growth holds.
valuation.principalRisk: Heavy Dupixent dependence and declining vaccines; Q3 data from a summary because the company release was blocked.
